title: Johnsoncab Electricals IPO Details
intro:
Johnsoncab Electricals IPO is a book build issue of ₹56.02 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 28.01 lakh shares of ₹56.02 crore.

Johnsoncab Electricals IPO opens for subscription on Oct 30, 2026 and closes on Nov 3, 2026. The allotment for the Johnsoncab Electricals IPO is expected to be finalized on Nov 4, 2026. Johnsoncab Electricals IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Nov 6, 2026.

Johnsoncab Electricals IPO is set issue price band at ₹190 to ₹200 per share. The lot size for an application is 600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,40,000 (1,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (1,800 shares), amounting to ₹3,60,000.

ISK Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Johnsoncab Electricals IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in November 2020, Johnsoncab Electricals Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of low voltage wires and cables up to 1.1 kV, catering to power infrastructure, transmission and distribution, renewable energy, railways and allied industrial applications. The company manufactures and sells its products under the brand name “JOHNSON CABLES” and caters to both private sector customers and government entities.

The company has a diversified product portfolio comprising control cables, power cables, industrial single and multicore control cables, housing and building wires, welding cables, solar/photovoltaic cables and submersible flat cables. It operates two manufacturing facilities in Mehsana, Gujarat, with a combined installed capacity of 79,950 KMS per annum as of Fiscal 2026. The manufacturing facilities are equipped with machinery for wire drawing, annealing, bunching, insulation, extrusion, testing and packaging.

Johnsoncab Electricals serves customers through direct orders, tender participation and vendor approval processes, with its products supported by ISO and BIS certifications. The company continues to invest in manufacturing infrastructure and product innovation to support its growth.
As of March 31, 2026, the company had 167 employees across various functions including production, operations, quality assurance, sales and marketing, supply chain, finance and administration.

The company has a diversified product portfolio comprising control cables, power cables, industrial single and multicore control cables, housing and building wires, welding cables, solar/photovoltaic cables and submersible flat cables. It operates two manufacturing facilities in Mehsana, Gujarat, with a combined installed capacity of 79,950 KMS per annum as of Fiscal 2026. The manufacturing facilities are equipped with machinery for wire drawing, annealing, bunching, insulation, extrusion, testing and packaging.

Johnsoncab Electricals serves customers through direct orders, tender participation and vendor approval processes, with its products supported by ISO and BIS certifications. The company continues to invest in manufacturing infrastructure and product innovation to support its growth.

As of March 31, 2026, the company had 167 employees across various functions including production, operations, quality assurance, sales and marketing, supply chain, finance and administration.

faqs.question: How to apply in Johnsoncab Electricals IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Johnsoncab Electricals IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Johnsoncab Electricals IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Johnsoncab Electricals IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Johnsoncab Electricals IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Johnsoncab Electricals IPO?
faqs.answer: Johnsoncab Electricals IPO lot size is 600 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,40,000 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Johnsoncab Electricals IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Johnsoncab Electricals IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Johnsoncab Electricals IPO will be done on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Nov 5, 2026 . Check the Johnsoncab Electricals IPO allotment status .

faqs.answer: The Johnsoncab Electricals IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Fri, Nov 6, 2026 .
